|game_text=When drawn for destiny, if three Ewoks and/or Wookiees on table, destiny +2. Deploy a bowcaster or Ewok weapon from Lost Pile. OR Take an Ewok or Wookiee of power < 6 into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During battle at same site as Part Of The Tribe, add one battle destiny.
|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E2 of [[Life Day]] (version 3 of 3). The image here is the slip on the Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf) (PDF created 2 August 2024), cut unchanged from page 6. This is the current text. Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

Deploy a bowcaster or Ewok weapon from Lost Pile. OR Take an Ewok or Wookiee of power < 6 into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During battle at same site as Part Of The Tribe, add one battle destiny.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Life Day (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Life Day (Errata)]] (published 24 July 2024) as a printable slip under the label “•Life Day”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
